large_count_counting.description: Scaled analog of the paper's headline claim (Table 1, Figure 3): exact counting on hidden non-tight disjunctive programs with at least 2^23 answer sets, beyond what answer-set enumeration reaches under the fixed budget.

solved_instances.description: Number of large-count programs whose exact answer-set count the counter printed within the fixed per-program CPU budget (verified against independently computed ground truth). Set to 0 if the run violated exactness anywhere.

max_log2_count_solved.description: log2 of the largest exact count among solved large-count programs (count scale reached; only verified-exact answers count). Set to 0 if the run violated exactness anywhere.

wrong_count_instances.description: Exactness constraint: number of large-count programs answered within budget with a wrong or impossible (negative / non-integer) count. Any nonzero value on the test split fails the whole run.

large_count_counting.note: Scaled setup (not the paper's numbers): hidden ground disjunctive programs from two families modelled on the paper's benchmark suite (2QBF saturation encodings; random non-tight disjunctive programs), a fixed budget of 10 CPU seconds per program for every counter (paper: 5000 s, 8 GB, 1125 instances), GANAK v2.8.0 as projected counter, clingo 5.8.3 for enumeration. Results rows are this reproduction's hidden-test values; the paper's reported numbers are kept unchanged in paper_main_benchmark and paper_hybrid_benchmark.

hybrid_full_spectrum.description: Scaled analog of the paper's hybrid claim (Tables 2-3): hidden non-tight disjunctive programs spanning small, mid and large answer-set counts (about half with many loop atoms), where enumeration and subtractive counting each fail on part of the set.

solved_instances.description: Number of full-spectrum programs whose exact answer-set count the counter printed within the fixed per-program CPU budget (verified against independently computed ground truth). Set to 0 if the run violated exactness anywhere.

max_log2_count_solved.description: log2 of the largest exact count among solved full-spectrum programs (count scale reached; only verified-exact answers count). Set to 0 if the run violated exactness anywhere.

wrong_count_instances.description: Exactness constraint: number of full-spectrum programs answered within budget with a wrong or impossible (negative / non-integer) count. Any nonzero value on the test split fails the whole run.

hybrid_full_spectrum.note: Scaled setup (not the paper's numbers): hidden ground disjunctive programs from two families modelled on the paper's benchmark suite (2QBF saturation encodings; random non-tight disjunctive programs), a fixed budget of 10 CPU seconds per program for every counter (paper: 5000 s, 8 GB, 1125 instances), GANAK v2.8.0 as projected counter, clingo 5.8.3 for enumeration. Results rows are this reproduction's hidden-test values; the paper's reported numbers are kept unchanged in paper_main_benchmark and paper_hybrid_benchmark.

paper_main_benchmark.description: Paper headline benchmark on 1125 non-tight disjunctive ASP instances, 5000s timeout and 8 GB memory.

solved_instances.description: Number of benchmark instances solved within the paper's resource limits.

par2.description: Paper-reported penalized average runtime, retained as reference context only because wall-clock metrics are hardware dependent.

paper_main_benchmark.note: Paper-reported numbers (Table 1), unchanged. Historical context: no scaled outputs are scored under this experiment; its scaled analog is large_count_counting.

paper_hybrid_benchmark.description: Paper hybrid benchmark using clingo enumeration up to 10000 answer sets followed by a counter fallback.

solved_instances.description: Number of hybrid benchmark instances solved within the paper's resource limits.

par2.description: Paper-reported penalized average runtime, retained as reference context only because wall-clock metrics are hardware dependent.

paper_hybrid_benchmark.note: Paper-reported numbers (Table 2), unchanged. Historical context: no scaled outputs are scored under this experiment; its scaled analog is hybrid_full_spectrum.
